title: Light weight, so it is unstable...
text: Light weight, so it is unstable.... If you want things as small as possible, this little heater is about two soda cans high, but it outputs the standard 750w to 1500w that other bigger units will do. I just don't like how unstable it is. It is very light, and so it tends to fall over if you're doing anything in the vicinity of it. For example, if you have it on a table, and you accidentally bump the table, just a little shake will tip it over. The good thing is there is a tip-over safety button at the bottom. So when it falls over, the button is no longer depressed, and everything will shut down. Still, it's too unstable. It needs a heavier base. The glossy black is also a dust magnet. 3-Stars.
